actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.

inputs.description: Camera selector; this package serves one configured camera, so the value is accepted and does not change the connection
inputs.name: camera

actions.name: capture

facts.text: The project synchronizes a Thorlabs DCC1545M camera with an Aerotech ANT130LZ nanopositioner
The hardware table names the Thorlabs DCC1545M (CMOS Monochrome, 1280 x 1024) and pyueye (uEye SDK) as the camera and its driver
The installation note says pyueye requires the IDS uEye SDK to be installed on the system
camera.py defines the camera interface class ThorlabsCamera
ThorlabsCamera.__init__ takes a device_id argument whose default is 0; the default is a constructor default, not a device bound
The constructor sets width to 1280 and height to 1024 pixels
The constructor calls is_SetColorMode with IS_CM_MONO8 without checking its return status
The constructor calls is_AllocImageMem for a 1280 x 1024 8-bit buffer and is_SetImageMem without checking either return status
capture_image calls is_FreezeVideo(IS_WAIT) without checking its return status, then copies the active image memory with get_data and reshapes it to (height, width)
release calls is_FreeImageMem and is_ExitCamera without checking either return status
The experiment calls camera.capture_image once for each stage position
The experiment constructs ThorlabsCamera(device_id=0) and AerotechStage(axis_name='Z') as separate objects
AerotechStage is a separate stage class in stage.py
requirements.txt lists pyueye as the camera dependency
